senses.definition_en: stillbirth, stillborn

examples.english: […] making us realize that in Santiago, the number of stillborns adds up to more than twice than in the rest of the country.
examples.ref: 1912, Trabajos y actas del Primer Congreso Nacional de Protección á la Infancia […], Santiago de Chile: Imprenta, Litografía y Encuadernación "Barcelona", page 318:
examples.text: […] haciéndonos notar que en la población de Santiago, las cifras de los mortinatos suman más del doble que las del resto del país.
examples.translation: […] making us realize that in Santiago, the number of stillborns adds up to more than twice than in the rest of the country.

examples.english: The number of deaths in children under five years of age—not taking stillborns into account—was 5,895, which is 1,672 more than in 1918.
examples.ref: 1920, Carlos M. Jimenez, “Salubridad e higiene”, in Memoria de gobernacion y policía presentada al Congreso Constitucional, San José, Costa Rica: Imprenta Nacional, page XXXV:
examples.text: La mortalidad de niños menores de 5 años—sin contar los mortinatos—fué de 5,895, o sean 1,672 más que en 1918.
examples.translation: The number of deaths in children under five years of age—not taking stillborns into account—was 5,895, which is 1,672 more than in 1918.

glosses: stillbirth, stillborn
